defs.def: a period of time, usually in history, that is different from other periods because of particular characteristics or events 时代；年代；纪元

ex.s: Hearing Dad’s cheerfulness, I realised that what I’d been seeing as “the end of an era” was actually the start of a new one.
ex.t: 听到爸爸的欢快，我意识到我一直视为“一个时代终结”的事情，其实是一个新时代的开始。

ex.s: In an earlier era, the Disruptor would have been called an Innovator.
ex.t: 然而创新者是创造新事物，而颠覆者的定义既在于他们创造的，同样也在于他们摧毁的。

ex.s: In Newton’s era, we imagined the universe as a clock.
ex.t: 在牛顿的时代，我们把宇宙想象成一座钟。

ex.s: In this “book of books,” artworks are selected and arranged in a way that emphasizes these connections between different eras and cultures.
ex.t: 在这本"书中的书"中，艺术作品的选取和编排方式强调了不同时代和文化之间的联系。

ex.s: Recent research suggests that if an argument gets resolved，the emotional response tied to it is significantly reduced or almost completely erased．Thus，it may be worth bringing up issues with your friends， family members，or classmates rather than holding them back．
ex.t: 最近的研究表明，如果一场争论得到解决，与之相关的情绪反应会显著减少，或几乎完全消除。因此，与其压抑，不如与朋友、家人或同学把问题提出来，可能最终会有更好的结果。

ex.s: What’s more, the Belt and Road Initiative will mean a new dawn for trade and investment between countries, leading into a new era of prosperity.
ex.t: 更重要的是，"一带一路"倡议将意味着国家间贸易和投资的新曙光，引领进入一个繁荣的新时代。

ex.s: The research conducted by these vessels is giving scientists a greater understanding of how the sea bed was formed, as well as helping identify areas for deep-sea drilling, taking deep-sea exploration into a whole new era.
ex.t: 这些科考船进行的研究让科学家对海床的形成有了更深入的了解，同时也有助于确定深海钻探的区域，将深海探索带入一个全新的时代。

ex.s: It is one of the largest and most well-preserved cities of the era, covering an area of 12 square kilometres.
ex.t: 它是那个时代规模最大、保存最完好的城市之一，占地 12 平方公里。

ex.s: When the silent era ended in 1929, Chaplin continued to make films, but these films had little or no dialogue.
ex.t: 当1929年无声电影时代结束时，卓别林继续拍电影，但这些电影几乎没有对白。

defs.def: a length of time which is a division of an aeon 代（地质年代，宙下分代）

ex.s: It has become part of the collective memory of the Chinese nation, with its spirit as the blueprint for all universities in China in the modern era.
ex.t: 它已成为中华民族集体记忆的一部分，其精神是现代中国所有大学的蓝本。
